# agentic-billing

Bill subscriptions, invoices, and metered units over Stripe.

Keywords: stripe, subscriptions, invoicing, agentic-suite, claude-code, codex, cli, mcp.

- SDK: import { createBillingAdapter } from "agentic-billing".
- Sibling usage: reportPackUsage(adapter, ledger, { pack, kind, customerId, units }).
- CLI: agentic-billing subscribe --email "..." --plan "...".
- MCP: run agentic-billing mcp, then call billing_subscribe.

## Docs

- README: https://github.com/pooriaarab/agentic-billing
- Core contract: https://github.com/pooriaarab/agentic-billing/blob/main/docs/agentic-core.md
